home.title: Volo WiFi Admin
home.guideSubtitle: Admin guide for tenant onboarding, billing, network, commerce, and analytics.
home.welcome: This console manages WiFi tenant registration, site licensing, service plans, partner commerce, RADIUS network configuration, and operational analytics. Use the sidebar to open modules your role can access.
home.accessNote: This home page is available to every signed-in user. Individual menus and actions depend on your assigned role and permissions.

onboarding.title: Tenant onboarding
onboarding.steps:
1. Register tenant and subscription (license).
2. Provision internal accounts and assign roles.
3. Configure service plans, pricing, and sites with capacity tiers.
4. Onboard partners with site mapping and entitlements.
5. Partners issue access tokens to end users.

licensing.title: Site licensing & invoicing
licensing.steps:
1. Define platform capacity tiers and default tier rates.
2. Optionally override tier rates per tenant.
3. Add licensed sites grouped by tier.
4. Generate monthly SaaS invoices (one line per site tier).

commerce.title: Partner commerce
commerce.steps:
1. Create partner and map sellable sites.
2. Entitle plans the partner may sell.
3. Partner issues access tokens from workspace.
4. Track orders, payments, and commission rules.

network.title: Network & RADIUS
network.steps:
1. Register NAS devices per site.
2. Configure vendor profiles and attribute catalog.
3. Attach RADIUS reply policies to service plans.
4. Monitor live sessions and auth events.

rules.r1: Every authenticated user can open this home page; other menus require role permissions.
rules.r2: Tenant registration creates org, license, and owner membership in one flow.
rules.r3: Monthly license billing is calculated per site capacity tier.
rules.r4: Partners can only sell plans and sites they are entitled to.
rules.r5: Access tokens require configured plans, pricing, and entitlements.
rules.r6: Platform billing setup menus are restricted to platform administrators.
rules.r7: Internal account provisioning only — no external email invites.
rules.r8: Soft-deleted records remain in the database but are hidden from normal lists.
